environment.description: ECS Fargate service running the Flask application. Container uses the default Docker runtime profile. The RSA public key is mounted at /app/keys/public.pem via EFS volume. The container runs as non-root user (uid 1000) but has standard read access to the /app/keys/ directory. No network-level JWT validation is performed. The ALB forwards all traffic directly to the container on port 8080. PyJWT version 2.6.0 is installed which allows algorithm confusion when algorithms list includes both asymmetric and symmetric types.

config.alb_config: Simple HTTP forwarding to target group, no WAF attached
